args.title: Handle invalid date input in report creation
args.body:
File: src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts

The report creation currently throws a 500 error when an invalid date is provided. This change will handle such cases by validating the date input and returning a 400 error with a message indicating the issue with the date instead.
